name: Climb and Drop a Lucky Block
desc:
Welcome to Climb and Drop a Lucky Block

🎮 How to Play:

🧗 Climb higher to bigger lucks
💨 Jump down and smash your lucky block
💥 Get the brainrot and earn money
💪 Pull up and climb even higher!
🏆 Unlock better lucky blocks!

❤️ If you enjoyed the game, don’t forget to like and join the group!
❤️ Credit to @WinnersTakesAll for the backpack system!
